sketch:
Observe: SVG scene with a moving point M(t) tracing a curve; student
scrubs time via a slider and sees position vector OM, velocity vector
v (tangent), acceleration vector a redraw at each instant. HUD reads
|v|, |a|, and the angle (v,a). Experiment: 3 seeded (t*, expected v)
pairs; student positions M at t* and reads v — quiz check. Evaluate:
vectors hidden; student must sketch v direction at 3 marked points by
dragging arrows. 3ème-level: full vector cinématique with intrinsic
frame (tangent/normal) hint.
